entities.name: Precinct Six
entities.description: A bustling industrial and mercantile district in the Tenth District of Ravnica, known for warehouses, busy streets and working-class neighborhoods.

entities.name: Tenth District
entities.description: The Ravnican district containing Precinct Six.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Guild that controls many warehouses and dominates commerce along Tin Street.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Guild that moves through the edges of Deadbridge Chasm, the gateway to its underground domain.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Guild that rents warehouse space and keeps a garrison at Kamen Fortress.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: Guild that operates pain clubs and rowdy street performances in the precinct.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: A goblin gang leader whose territory includes Foundry Street.

entities.name: Medori
entities.description: An Orzhov pontiff who transformed Medori Park into warehouse lots.

entities.name: Nyoser
entities.description: The viashino who runs the Gore House pain club.

entities.name: Falish
entities.description: A renegade Izzet toolsmith with connections to Krenko who runs Falish's Workshop.

entities.name: Wyroon
entities.description: A male minotaur who runs The Millstone tavern and was ousted from the Boros Legion for insubordination.

entities.name: Noggra
entities.description: A female goblin alchemist who runs Noggra's Remedies.

entities.name: Deadbridge Chasm
entities.description: A vast fissure that serves as an entrance to the Golgari undercity and guildhall Korozda.

entities.name: Kamen Fortress
entities.description: Former headquarters of the Theater of Order, now a Boros garrison watching the Cult of Rakdos.

entities.name: Medori Park
entities.description: A former city park turned warehouse lots, rife with undead at night.

entities.name: Tin Street
entities.description: A long mercantile street, turf of the Shattergang Brothers in this part.

entities.name: Gore House
entities.description: A Cult of Rakdos pain club that hides the entrance to the Demon's Vestibule.

entities.name: Shattergang Brothers
entities.description: Group whose turf includes this part of Tin Street.

events.summary: The Orzhov pontiff Medori transformed Medori Park from a city park into warehouse lots.
